summary: ACC document manifest + current review (Issue #14): acc_decisions gains document_manifest (every document with its original filename, kind, source email, received time), document_intake_errors (attachments that could not be fetched or stored), and current_review_text / current_ai_recommendation / current_letter_body / current_review_at / current_review_basis (the review re-run against the current document set; the original intake analysis is untouched). No rows written; nothing sets a decision, status or send.

preflight.name: acc_decisions has no document_manifest / current_review columns yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'acc_decisions' AND column_name IN ('document_manifest','document_intake_errors','current_review_text','current_ai_recommendation','current_letter_body','current_review_at','current_review_basis')

expected_changes: Adds acc_decisions.document_manifest jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT [] and document_intake_errors jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT [], each with an is-array CHECK.
Adds acc_decisions.current_review_text, current_ai_recommendation, current_letter_body (text), current_review_at (timestamptz), current_review_basis (jsonb), all nullable.
No row changes; existing cases start with an empty manifest and no current review.

verify.name: no existing case got a manifest, an error or a current review
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM acc_decisions WHERE document_manifest <> '[]'::jsonb OR document_intake_errors <> '[]'::jsonb OR current_review_text IS NOT NULL OR current_review_at IS NOT NULL
